title: Woodnuts
synopsis: Desperate for credits, a punch-burn laborer joins a hazard crew harvesting psychoactive sap from the forests of Jatar. Seduced by whispers from the ancient trees, he's lured into the deep woods and consumed by the forest's memories — witnessing the terraforming of the planet by ancient humans, the rise of a paradise on a once-barren world, and humanity's destruction by the very ecosystem it engineered.

audienceReactions.quote: The idea of being consumed by memories instead of something physical… that's next level.
audienceReactions.author: YouTube viewer

audienceReactions.quote: "The closer to the edge you get, the more you want to taste it." Excellent quote.
